g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Route Planning
AV2 Design Proposal - US14, US20, TS03
Origin, mode, available offers and opening windows
Remaining stores, skipped stop and replacement request
Coverage, travel estimates and data timestamp
No mutation or automatic replan from a query
Replan from the buyer's current origin through remaining stores.
Closed, unreachable or unavailable candidates are not valid replacements.
Failed generation/recalculation emits no success event and preserves the old plan.
Incomplete baskets expose missing products and cannot claim complete savings.
Configure provider, exact-search stop limit, travel modes and deadline.
Trusted list, price, availability and opening-window snapshots need provisioning.
Automatic reactions to Catalog/Merchant events remain future integration work.
No ACL or unimplemented subscription is introduced.
